facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The kitchen smelled wonderful. Ms. Clara made a warm soup. She baked fresh bread too. Father came in from work. Mother put down her book. Emma carried the bowls. Ben placed the forks. The family ate together.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Ms. Clara called everyone to the dinner table for the first time in weeks. The candle was lit, and a small bouquet of garden flowers sat in the center. Father came in from the garden, brushing soil from his hands, and Mother set down her book with a happy sigh. Emma carried the bowls one by one, her tongue sticking out in concentration. Ben placed forks at each seat, counting carefully so no one was left out. A warm pot of soup sat in the middle of the table, with steam rising in slow curls. They held hands for a moment of thanks. The family ate together, and the cottage felt full.
